python3 -c "
import sys
path = '/work/report.pdf'
try:
    from pypdf import PdfReader
    print(len(PdfReader(path).pages))
except Exception:
    try:
        import PyPDF2
        print(len(PyPDF2.PdfReader(open(path,'rb')).pages))
    except Exception as e:
        data = open(path,'rb').read()
        # Count PDF page objects conservatively via /Type /Page not /Pages
        import re
        pages = len(re.findall(rb'/Type\s*/Page(?!s)', data))
        print(pages)
"
